title: SQL injection through the order id
description: The raw path parameter is concatenated into the SQL; parseInt('1 OR 1=1') passes the validation above, so the check does not protect the query.

title: Any signed-in user can read any order
description: The customer_id condition was dropped, so the order is returned without checking that it belongs to the caller.

title: Error details and stack traces are sent to the client
description: The 500 response exposes internal messages and the stack trace, which can reveal queries, paths and libraries.
